<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organisation" processRef="complaint-process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="complaint-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="complaint-lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="lane-customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>file-complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>provide-feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane-service" name="Customer service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>log-complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>assign-complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>mark-resolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane-department" name="Relevant department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>review-details</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>determine-validity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notify-customer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>refund-decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane-finance" name="Financial team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>process-reimbursement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Complaint process started" />
    <bpmn:task id="file-complaint" name="File a complaint about a product or service" />
    <bpmn:task id="log-complaint" name="Log the complaint" />
    <bpmn:task id="assign-complaint" name="Assign the complaint to the relevant department" />
    <bpmn:task id="review-details" name="Review the details" />
    <bpmn:task id="determine-validity" name="Determine whether the complaint is valid and whether a refund is justified" />
    <bpmn:task id="notify-customer" name="Notify the customer of the decision" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="refund-decision" name="Refund approved?" />
    <bpmn:task id="process-reimbursement" name="Process the reimbursement" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="merge" />
    <bpmn:task id="mark-resolved" name="Mark the complaint as resolved" />
    <bpmn:task id="provide-feedback" name="Provide feedback on satisfaction" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Complaint closed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="file-complaint" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="file-complaint" targetRef="log-complaint" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="log-complaint" targetRef="assign-complaint" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="assign-complaint" targetRef="review-details" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="review-details" targetRef="determine-validity" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="determine-validity" targetRef="notify-customer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="notify-customer" targetRef="refund-decision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" name="yes" sourceRef="refund-decision" targetRef="process-reimbursement" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" name="no" sourceRef="refund-decision" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="process-reimbursement" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="merge" targetRef="mark-resolved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="mark-resolved" targetRef="provide-feedback" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="provide-feedback" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
